newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Mandela's daughter takes ride in stolen car.
newsitem.headline: Mandela's daughter takes ride in stolen car.

text.p: President Nelson Mandela's daughter Zinzi was one of three people in a stolen car stopped in the crime-ridden township of Soweto, police said on Thursday.
Zinzi Mandela-Hlongwane, her husband and a friend who was driving the BMW when it was pulled over on Wednesday night were released after questioning, they said.
Mandela's spokesman Parks Mankahlana said the president's daughter had nothing to do with the theft of the car.
The police said in a statement that officers had stopped the driver of the luxury car on charges of reckless driving.
Checks indicated that the car, which had been borrowed from an acquaintance, had been stolen earlier this year.
"The vehicle was confiscated and investigations are continuing," the police said.
Zinzi Mandela-Hlongwane is one of Mandela's two daughters by his second wife Winnie, whom he divorced last year.
